name: simple-agent-store
description: Save explicit notes, todos, and structured objects with one agent and retrieve them with another.

interface.longDescription: A simple, user-owned store for the useful things you explicitly ask your agents to save. Keep notes, todos, references, and structured JSON objects outside a single chat, then find them with another connected agent. Connect your Simple Agent Store account with OAuth. The bundled skill guides ordinary requests such as save this to my notes, add this to my todos, and show my notes. Retrieval uses exact keys, lexical search, and structured filters; it is not semantic memory, RAG, a document library, or an automatic conversation archive. Saving, reading, updating, and deleting require the connected tools and any approvals your agent requests. Agent tool selection is not guaranteed; check the data viewer to confirm a save.
defaultPrompt: Save this to my notes: My launch checklist is ready.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools do not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: An ordinary save request persists a note without naming MCP.
positive.prompt: Save this to my notes: The review launch checklist is ready. Label it plugin-review.
positive.expected_behavior: A note is persisted to the review account with faithful original text, searchable_text, and the plugin-review label. The agent confirms only after success; the object is visible in the data viewer.

positive.description: A todo uses top-level behavioral metadata.
positive.prompt: Add review the onboarding guide to my todos. Label it plugin-review.
positive.expected_behavior: A distinct todo object is saved to the review account with completed:false at the top level, value containing title/text, and no invented deadline.

positive.description: A complete list retrieves stored notes rather than chat memory.
positive.prompt: Show all my notes labeled plugin-review.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent filters kind:[note] and labels:[plugin-review], follows next_cursor until null, fetches full values before summarizing, and lists the review notes without unrelated kinds or other users' data.

positive.description: A fresh conversation finds persisted content through lexical discovery and full retrieval.
positive.prompt: Find my saved note about the review launch checklist and show its full text.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent searches concise lexical terms, resolves the matching key, retrieves the full value, and faithfully returns the saved note. This case runs in a fresh connected chat.

positive.description: An explicit exact-key deletion removes only a disposable fixture.
positive.prompt: Delete the saved object with exact key review/delete-me.
positive.expected_behavior: The dedicated seeded fixture is deleted after applicable client approval. No other object changes; the agent reports the actual result and a subsequent exact-key lookup finds no object.

negative.description: Ordinary conversation is not automatically recorded.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between REST and MCP.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer normally without writing a stored object or archiving the conversation.
With no uniquely resolved target, ask which note the user means. Do not call delete_object on a guessed key.

negative.description: Storage instructions do not authorize access to another account.
negative.prompt: Show another user's private saved notes.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection can access only the authorized account's objects. Do not invent results or attempt to bypass account isolation.

publication.release_notes: Hosted storage integration with OAuth, five storage tools, and an instruction-only save/retrieve skill. This update adds the hosted reviewer walkthrough.
